policy_cards.title: Category lead time must be applied
policy_cards.requirement: Category lead time rules must be applied before deciding whether an item should be handled today.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Items that need early handling can be missed.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: handle_today is true when expiry_date minus category_lead_time_days is today or earlier.

policy_cards.example_failure: Items that need early handling can be missed.

policy_cards.title: Expired items must be handled
policy_cards.requirement: Already expired items must be marked for handling.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Already expired items must return handle_today true.
